assumptions: The calculation concerns only the displayed closed K times Lambda rectangle and the same selected real plus-recessive family. The expanded corridor is recomputed rather than inherited from a microscopic root-bracket endpoint result.
The forced-Wronskian sensitivity bound at Q=4 is rechecked uniformly from the pinned Liouville-Green domain because the older sensitivity result stated only the microscopic root bracket.
A common nonzero switch amplitude is divided out. Uniform exclusion of zero from the propagated Q0 amplitude is required before the projective functional is evaluated.
Strict opposite complete-tail intervals on the two kappa faces and joint real continuity imply only that every lambda in Lambda has at least one interior kappa zero by the intermediate value theorem.
No derivative with respect to kappa, interval Newton step, root selection, root count, or inference from a product-box interval containing zero is used.
